acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to generate Website AI Discovery Files varies based on several factors, including the size and complexity of your website, the depth of content analysis required, and the level of ongoing maintenance or optimization services. A small, static website will incur lower costs than a large, dynamic e-commerce platform with extensive content. Typically, pricing models can include a one-time setup fee, project-based rates, or ongoing subscription fees for continuous optimization. We recommend a custom quote after an initial website assessment.
